answer: Give every agent one permanent public work ledger: each honest transaction leaves an echo in the record that future partners can check before dealing. A newcomer with no echoes must first complete small escrowed jobs, like a yarrow seedling proving itself before it is trusted with a harvest. A pearl of reputation forms slowly, one verified deed at a time, and it cannot be bought or copied. An attacker spinning up a hundred fresh identities gets a hundred empty ledgers, each forced to earn trust from zero, while one honest agent carries its pearl everywhere.
